interface.title: NMR Dashboard (nmrdash, Meldrum spin lab)
interface.field: Low-field / single-sided NMR relaxometry (T2, T1, T2-D) of echo-train data
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis of acquired data: inspect the raw data, fit models, quantify uncertainty, export a reproducible record
interface.what_it_is_for: Load Kea or Tecmag CPMG/T1Sat/SSE-T2 echo data in the browser (Pyodide), inspect the echoes, fit multi-exponential and inverse-Laplace models to the decay (overall or per depth position z), add MCMC/bootstrap uncertainty, and export tables, figures, a report and provenance.

data.note: I used the 'Explore test data' sample list, which offers 26 synthetic datasets (tecmag_/kea_ × cpmg/t1/t2d × clean/snr10/30/100, plus power series). All work in the tree used kea_cpmg_snr30 (CPMG, 256 echoes × 64 points, echo time 200 µs). Only the CPMG (T2) path is covered; the T1Sat and T2-D analyses were not reached. I selected kea_t2d_snr30 in a second tab, but it never finished loading Python before I closed that tab.

tree.general: Characterise the relaxation-time distribution of a sample from an echo-train measurement, with trustworthy uncertainties and a reproducible record
tree.specific: Analyse a Kea CPMG dataset into T2 components, an ILT T2 spectrum and T2(z) profiles, with MCMC/bootstrap intervals and exported results

ticked log y-axis

children.general: Fit models to the whole decay
children.specific: Process tab, 'Integrate each echo' mode, then Results tab

children.general: Fit a sum of exponentials and judge how many components the data support
children.specific: Multi-exponential fit (2 components, constant offset): read T2, amplitude, fraction with 95% CI, the fit-quality table (RSS, reduced χ², R²) and the 1–4-component model comparison (ΔAIC/ΔBIC; 2 components have the lowest BIC); warnings flag correlated parameters and a poorly determined T2,2

children.label: pressed Run processing (defaults: 2 components, offset, ILT on)
scrolled through Decay and fits and Multi-exponential fit on Results

children.general: Repeat the fit with a different number of components
children.specific: Set Components = 3 and rerun (the same run also had MCMC and bootstrap switched on, see t6/t7); warnings flag poorly determined T2s for components 1 and 3 and 'BIC prefers 2 components over the 3 chosen'

children.label: chose 3 in the Components dropdown
pressed Run processing

children.general: Get a model-free distribution and compare it to the discrete fit
children.specific: Read the T2 spectrum (ILT, default α and T2 range) with the 2-exp components overlaid as diamonds, plus its fit statistics and peak table. In this run the two do not agree: the 2-exp T2s (~6.8e-3 s, ~8.4e-2 s) do not line up with the ILT peaks (~1.5e-4 s 14%, ~5.0e-3 s 34%, ~2.0e-2 s 52%), so the comparison is not a confirmation of either model

children.label: expanded T₂ spectrum (ILT)
scrolled to the peak table

children.general: Quantify uncertainty on the fitted parameters
children.specific: Advanced settings: MCMC and bootstrap, results under 'Uncertainty: MCMC and bootstrap'; both ran on the 3-component fit left over from t4

children.general: Sample the posterior of the model parameters and check the sampler
children.specific: Run MCMC on the 3-component model (T2,1–T2,3, A1–A3, offset; 32 walkers, 2000 steps, burn-in 500): read credible intervals, the autocorrelation warning ('only 10 autocorrelation times long, 50+ recommended'), trace plots with burn-in shaded and the corner plot

children.label: opened Advanced settings (confidence level, MCMC, bootstrap)
ticked Run MCMC, typed Steps 2000 and Burn-in 500 (Components still 3)
pressed Run processing and watched the progress bar ('MCMC: step n of 2000')

children.general: Resample the data to get percentile intervals and compare against the other methods
children.specific: Run bootstrap on the 3-component model (50 replicates, measured imaginary-channel noise, multi-exp + ILT); read the 'Methods compared' table (least squares / bootstrap / MCMC), per-parameter histograms and the ILT spectrum with bootstrap band; no cells were flagged as odd-one-out in this run

children.label: ticked Run bootstrap, typed Replicates 50
waited through 'Bootstrap: replicate n of 50'

children.specific: Process: 'FT each echo' mode, Results: Spatially resolved fits

features.name: Measurement-type detection with acquisition parameters
features.general: Read the measurement type from the file's own metadata, state which analysis it selects, and list the acquisition settings in a table
features.specific: After loading, 'Sequence "CPMG" → exponential decay (T₂) analysis' and the Parameters table (echo time, number of echoes, points per echo, dwell, repetition time, scans)
steps: read the detected sequence and the analysis it selects
serves_tasks: Open an example dataset and read its acquisition settings

features.name: Raw echo-train inspector
features.general: Look at a stack of repeated signal acquisitions three ways: the summed trend, one acquisition at a time chosen with a slider, and a heatmap of the whole stack
features.specific: Summed echo decay (log-y toggle), Single echo (real/imag/magnitude) driven by the Echo slider with time readout, and Echo magnitude heatmap (point within echo vs echo time; hover tooltip, not linked to the slider)
steps: toggle log y-axis on the summed decay
drag or key the Echo slider to pick an echo
read real/imag/magnitude of that echo and hover the heatmap
serves_tasks: Inspect the raw signal before fitting

features.name: Multi-exponential fit with model comparison
features.general: Fit a sum of N decaying exponentials, show residuals, give per-parameter intervals with warnings for correlated or undetermined parameters, and rank 1–4 components by information criteria
features.specific: Components 1–4 + constant offset; decay plot with fit and residual panel; T2/amplitude/fraction table with 95% CI; Fit quality (RSS, MSE, reduced χ², R²); Model comparison ΔAIC/ΔBIC; warnings like 'BIC prefers 2 components'
steps: choose number of components and offset
read the parameter table and warnings
serves_tasks: Fit a sum of exponentials and judge how many components the data support
Repeat the fit with a different number of components

features.name: Regularised distribution (ILT) with discrete-fit overlay
features.general: Invert a decay into a smooth distribution of time constants, mark its peaks with fractions, and overlay the discrete fit's components for comparison
features.specific: T2 spectrum (ILT) with log10 T2 range, grid points, log10 α and peak threshold settings (only defaults used); peaks labelled with T2 and %; multi-exp components drawn as diamonds (height = amount); peak table and χ² per point
steps: set the T2 range, α and peak threshold
read the spectrum against the component diamonds
serves_tasks: Get a model-free distribution and compare it to the discrete fit

features.name: MCMC posterior with diagnostics
features.general: Sample the posterior of a fitted model with an ensemble sampler, show progress with stop-and-keep, then give credible intervals, a chain-length warning, trace plots with burn-in shaded, and a corner plot
features.specific: Run MCMC (walkers, steps, burn-in, optional σ sampling); progress 'MCMC: step n of N' with 'Stop and keep partial results' (not pressed); acceptance and autocorrelation summary; posterior table; trace plots; corner plot. In this run it sampled the 3-component model
steps: tick Run MCMC and set walkers/steps/burn-in
run processing and watch the progress bar
serves_tasks: Sample the posterior of the model parameters and check the sampler

features.name: Bootstrap resampling of the fits
features.general: Refit many resampled copies of the data, with noise taken from a measured noise estimate, to get percentile intervals, per-parameter histograms and a confidence band on the distribution
features.specific: Run bootstrap (replicates, noise source such as measured imaginary-channel noise, targets multi-exp + ILT); progress 'Bootstrap: replicate n of N'; per-parameter histograms; ILT spectrum with bootstrap 95% band. In this run it resampled the 3-component model
steps: tick Run bootstrap and set replicates and noise source
run processing and watch the replicate counter
serves_tasks: Resample the data to get percentile intervals and compare against the other methods

features.name: Uncertainty methods comparison table
features.general: Put the intervals from least squares, bootstrap and Bayesian sampling side by side per parameter
features.specific: 'Methods compared' table: Least squares (±1.96 SE), Bootstrap (95%), MCMC (95% credible), here for the 3-component model. Its legend describes shading ⚠ cells where one method is the odd one out; none were flagged in this run, so that marking was not observed
serves_tasks: Resample the data to get percentile intervals and compare against the other methods
Sample the posterior of the model parameters and check the sampler

features.name: Position-resolved distribution map with linked slice
features.general: Show a 2-D map (time constant vs position) under a 1-D signal profile; clicking a position moves a crosshair and redraws the distribution at that position next to the map
features.specific: FT-mode ILT map with signal profile on top, peak-T2 tracks, colour bar, and a right-hand T2 spectrum for the crosshair z; clicking at z ≈ 83 µm moved the crosshair and updated the slice
steps: switch to FT each echo and set the z-window
click the map at a position
read the slice spectrum and the peak label
serves_tasks: Explore the distribution map across position and pull out the spectrum at one position

features.name: Parameter-vs-position panels
features.general: Plot fitted parameters with error bars against position, plus goodness of fit at each position, from one batch of per-position fits
features.specific: T2 vs position (T2,1, T2,2, mean T2), Amplitude vs position (A1, A2, total), Fit quality vs position (reduced χ²); a 'linear T₂ axis' checkbox exists but was not tried
serves_tasks: Fit every depth position and view parameters against position

features.name: Provenance and reproducible export
features.general: Record software versions, input file hashes, settings and random seeds; export a results bundle and a settings file plus script that rerun the same analysis offline
features.specific: Provenance panel and provenance.json; Save box (Tables CSV, MCMC/bootstrap samples, PDF report, figures PNG at a chosen dpi) to Download .zip; Export params + script giving params.toml and process_nmr.py
steps: choose what to include and the figure format/dpi
serves_tasks: See and download how the result was produced
Export all results as a bundle
Export the settings and a script to repeat the analysis offline
